headline: Ipswich and Nottingham Forest share points after 1–1 draw

sentences.text: Ipswich Town and Nottingham Forest shared the points after a 1–1 draw in their Premier League matchweek 8 meeting at Portman Road.
Neco Williams put Nottingham Forest ahead in the 13th minute, with Daniel Muñoz providing the assist.
Ipswich levelled before half-time when Julio Enciso scored in the 41st minute.
The score remained unchanged after the break, with neither side finding a second-half goal.
Nottingham Forest had the greater attacking output, recording 17 shots to Ipswich's 7 and 2.29 expected goals to 0.46.
Forest also had 5 corners to Ipswich's 0, while possession was nearly even at 50.6% to 49.4%.
The draw lifted Ipswich to 9th with 10 points, while Nottingham Forest moved to 16th with 6 points.
